violated_contract: A merged-order memory list stream must keep emitting canonical heads after its historical window is exhausted: once every historical window is consumed, the merge loop raised MemoryIndexWindowLimit before take_canonical ran, so migrated accounts whose historical rows are all canonical_identity-suppressed received empty pages with a continuation cursor (reproduced as 8 consecutive empty pages for a 40-memory account at limit=5), which offset-paging clients render as an empty memories screen.
canonical_prevention: On window-limit, expose the exhausted streams' lower bound and keep emitting canonical heads whose window_sort_key is at or newer than that bound; raise window_limited only when the canonical head is older than the bound or canonical is exhausted. Pin the contract with a suppressed-historical-plus-canonical page test, and keep invalid-cursor fallbacks on read_page(cursor=None) so cursor clients always receive a continuation instead of a silent truncation.
